messages:
sam-partnerships: Flagging a flaky OOM on MI300 in eu-west during long-context evals (rebel-13b, seq=8k). Need quick operational plan: marketplace hint + routing fallback + short SI test window.

ken-eng: Copy. Minimal repro? Which instance and error log?

sam-partnerships: Repro: `rebel-13b@v3`, seq_len=8192, batch=1, inst mi300-eu-03. Log: 'GPU OOM during KV-append'. Looks like cache growth.

tess-platform: Short-term mitigation: route a small canary to H100/H200 in eu (5% -> 25% -> 100%) and push a non-breaking marketplace suggestion for EU SKUs.

lara-cloud: I can prepare marketplace PR. Proposed SKU mapping: rebel-13b -> EU fallback [H100-XL, H200-STD]. Hold until SI window confirmed.

vendor-mi300: Acknowledged. We can reproduce. RC driver build available in ~48-72h. Interim: set `gpu_mem_guard=0.85`, avoid quantized images for canary.

vendor-gaudi: We will run extended seq parity tests on Gaudi if you share commit/tag; no issues seen so far.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-555 created: "MI300 EU long-seq OOM". Runbook stub: internal link posted.

sam-partnerships: Action owners: @tess-platform routing & canary, @lara-cloud marketplace PR, @ken-eng perf delta eval, vendors to provide RC + test reports. Reconvene once RC or in 48h. :thumbsup:
